title: Three Autumns and One Short Basket
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：mist　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 mist 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the farmer ① cleared the mist that no child in the field would have recorded, and he said the clearing was the whole of the autumn. The ② mist, meaning the cloud itself and not the basket, ran three autumns and stayed unrecorded in the book; mist, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ sort of mist in that field had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ mist at the far fence, meaning the seed they kept for the children to sow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Mist, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the farmer said the recording is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the mist was the whole of the matter, meaning the doubt and not the cloud. The ⑥ mist, meaning the doubt and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; mist, he said, is either something you clear or the only word that means both cloud and a doubt. He said the doubt is the part they remember.

By 1974 the ⑦ mist had become a line in an almanac, and the almanac had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ mist of the whole thing, the farmer wrote in September, was one field and three autumns of recording; mist, he said, is either the seed at the far fence or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ mist I remember is the mist recorded in the almanac, which closed in 1976 and is still recorded as the quietest in the field. ⑩ Mist, my mother said in 1978, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all mist, she said, is a doubt that has agreed to look like cloud. She said the doubt was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 薄雾；雾气（指田垄里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 薄雾；雾气（指那层薄雾本身，与小小的竹篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：clear the mist 拨开这一层薄雾
D. n. 薄雾；雾气（指留给孩子们播的那一把）
E. n. 薄雾之事（抽象总称，指一处田垄的薄雾之事）
F. n. 薄雾；雾气（指农事历里写到、被记载的那一层）
G. n. 薄雾、迷蒙（指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 迷蒙（抽象总称，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: cleared the mist that no child in the field would have recorded
The mist, meaning the cloud itself and not the basket
Every sort of mist in that field
the mist at the far fence
the mist was the whole of the matter
the mist had become a line in an almanac
The mist of the whole thing

answers.why: clear the mist 意为“拨开这一层薄雾”，1969 年那位农人把田垄里没有一位孩子肯记载的一层薄雾做了一遍。
mist 意为“薄雾；雾气”，指那层薄雾本身而不是小小的竹篮，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被记载。
mist 意为“薄雾；雾气”，指田垄里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一只小小的竹篮。
mist 意为“薄雾；雾气”，指最远那道篱边的留给孩子们播的那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
mist 意为“薄雾、迷蒙”，指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这层迷蒙就是那件事的全部。
mist 意为“迷蒙”，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西而不是那层薄雾，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
mist 意为“薄雾；雾气”，指农事历里写到、被记载的那一层，到 1974 年这一层成了农事历里的一行。
mist 意为“薄雾之事”，农人九月写道，整件事的薄雾之事是一处田垄和三个秋天的记载。
mist 意为“薄雾；雾气”，我记得的是农事历里记载过的那一层，1976 年收完了，至今仍被说成田垄里最安静的一层。
mist 为抽象总称，母亲 1978 年说，薄雾是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的薄雾。
